description: Get the WhatsApp business account and phone number profile.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the business profile object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List WhatsApp contacts, optionally restricted to opted-in contacts.

opted_in_only.description: When true, only contacts who have opted in are returned (default false).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of contact objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single WhatsApp contact by its wa_id.

wa_id.description: The WhatsApp id of the contact.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the contact object; on failure (contact not found), output contains an error message.

description: List message templates, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: Optional template status to filter by (e.g. APPROVED); case-insensitive.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of template objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single message template by its name.

name.description: The unique name of the template.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the template object; on failure (template not found), output contains an error message.

description: List conversations, optionally filtered by contact wa_id, ordered by most recent activity.

wa_id.description: Optional contact wa_id to filter conversations by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of conversation objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List messages, filtered by conversation or contact, ordered by most recent.

conversation_id.description: Optional conversation id to filter messages by.

wa_id.description: Optional contact wa_id to filter messages by (used when conversation_id is not given).

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 20).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of message objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Send a text message to a contact within the 24-hour customer service window.

body.description: The text body of the message.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has a 'messages' list with the accepted message id; on failure (not opted in or outside window), output contains an error message.

description: Send an approved template message to a contact, creating a conversation if needed.

template_name.description: The name of the approved template to send.

components.description: Optional list of template component objects for parameter substitution.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output has a 'messages' list with the accepted message id; on failure (contact/template not found or not approved), output contains an error message.

description: Mark a message as read by its message id.

message_id.description: The id of the message to mark as read.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms success with the message id; on failure (message not found), output contains an error message.
